title: It’s garbage now
body: this was, by a mile and a half, my favourite app - because my phone is NOT an extension of me, it’s a tool ! It used to be simple, no nonsense : write a note, set a reminder time or location, done - use it daily to dump my brain; nowadays it’s pure garbage : every number is trying to become a date a time or a mix of both, it tries to guess what a simple code is and ads it to calendar because reasons ( never mind type it with the constant annoying autocorrect ) have PTSD every time I repeat a word or an item even if I want to have it on different lists, which I’m now forced to have, colour, name, assign, organise and select which other 50 apps need to know about what shenanigans going about “washing liquid” - I can imagine a bunch of people in a room thinking : how can we ruin peoples experience today ? New reminders is born; congrats on not being able to perform such a simple task as “making your own bed” as you wake up, it’s beyond me how you dress yourself and tie your own shoes - go step on a Lego !
